page.layout: One printed page: page number at head centre; title heading in capitals; a Greek ornamental line with italic subtitle "Augustano interprete."; then one column of running text with a large woodcut initial A at the start; catchword/signature line at foot ("1 2 mul-" is a signature line with catchword "mul-" at right).

main_text.head: M. ANTONINI IMPERATORIS DE VITA SUA, Liber I.
[illegible, ~40 letters]
main_text.p: ABuo meo Vero didici placidis esse moribus & irae abstinēs. Exīstimatione parentis mei, eiusq; recordatione, ad verecundiam & viro dignos mores vsus sum. Matrem in studio pietatis erga deos, liberalitateq; imitatus: praeterea in abstinendo à non perpetrandis modò, sed & cogitādis flagitijs: tum in frugalitate victus, ab opulentiam comitante luxu remotissima. A patre proauo id habui, vt ne in publicos ludos commearem, sed bonis praeceptoribus domi meae vterer: intelligeremque nullis hac in re parcendum sumptib. Ab educatore, ne auriga prasinus, aut venetus, neue palmularius aut scutarius fierē: ab eodem, tolerare labores, esse contentus paruo, operari, non immiscere me mul-

page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter, joined to "B" as "ABuo" in reading; the first word is printed "Abuo" with the woodcut initial. Title and running text are in a single column. The Greek ornamental line is illegible. Marginal ornaments and ink blots are not transcribed. Marked uncertainties: "Ab educatore" and "sumptib" may be misprinted; the first word of the text is probably "Abuo" (A + B, woodcut initial).
